text:
Priya N.: heads-up: running the onboarding webhook smoke tests against the new go-sdk 0.9.3 and node-sdk 1.4.0 and seeing double-processing on create events when upstream returns 429s during key rotation.

Leo M.: can you summarize repro and which SDK did what?

Priya N.: repro:
  1) start webhook receiver (sampleapp-webhook)
  2) send burst of 100 create events at t=0 using load-generator
  3) trigger auth key swap on auth service at t=5s
  4) observe a sequence of 429s and immediate retries from the client side

Observed behavior:
- node-sdk: attaches `Idempotency-Key` header generated by caller (app), retries backoff=0.2s->0.4s with full-jitter, duplicate count ~= 0
- go-sdk: when caller omits idempotency header, go-sdk does NOT auto-generate one. backoff uses `equal-jitter` implementation with low min (25ms) so multiple clients sync and replay. duplicates observed ~ 4% of events.

Logs (go-sdk client):
```
WARN 2026-03-23T09:10:12Z retry.go: got 429 attempt=1 backoff_ms=25 jitter_ms=6
INFO 2026-03-23T09:10:12Z retry.go: retrying request (no idempotency key)
WARN 2026-03-23T09:10:12Z retry.go: got 429 attempt=2 backoff_ms=25 jitter_ms=5
ERROR 2026-03-23T09:10:13Z webhook-handler: processed duplicate event id=evt_7f3b
```

Priya N.: QA ran same test against node-sdk and didn't see dupes. so two root issues: SDK parity (auto-idempotency behavior) and jitter/backoff choice.

Leo M.: ack. Proposed fixes:
  - go-sdk: auto-generate Idempotency-Key for POST/PUT if caller didn't set one, format `idemp-<svc>-<user>-<ts>-<rand6>`
  - change go-sdk default jitter to `full-jitter` and increase base backoff to 100ms for hosted envs
  - expose env var `REDWOOD_SDK_BACKOFF_STRATEGY` for parity testing
  - sampleapp-webhook: fail-safe dedupe at receiver using short-lived in-memory cache (TTL 5s) + metrics `webhook_dedupe_hits`

CI Bot: go-sdk PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/198 — adding auto idempotency + full-jitter switch. Tests added.

Priya N.: can we also ensure SDK emits `X-Generated-Idempotency: true` in logs/headers for debug so QA can tell when SDK auto-injected key?

Leo M.: yep, add header `X-Redwood-Debug-Idemp: auto` when generated and log `idemp_origin=auto` in client debug logs. wont be on by default in prod.

QA Team: we'll run a matrix: go-sdk old vs new, node-sdk baseline, and sampleapp dedupe on/off. ETA 24h. will post artifacts.

Priya N.: thanks. one more note: let's add a small unit test that simulates key rotation + 429 burst with deterministic jitter seed so behavior is reproducible in CI.

Leo M.: good call. adding `--jitter-seed` flag to the retry harness in both SDKs. will land after CI passes. :white_check_mark:
